description_en: Renders templates written in Go template syntax by using the provided context data and returns the rendering results. This operation supports the simultaneous preview of multiple templates, such as title and content, to enable real-time preview in frontend template editors
description_zh: 传入 Go template 语法的模板内容和渲染上下文数据，返回各模板的渲染结果。支持同时预览多个模板（如 title 和 content），用于前端模板编辑器的实时预览能力
kebab_example: aliyun cms preview-notify-template --templates '[{"template":"云监控报警: {{.incident.title}}","key":"title"},{"template":">- 级别: {{.incident.severity}}","key":"content"}]' --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PreviewNotifyTemplate

parameters.help_en: The rendering context data in key-value pair format. This data source is used to populate Go template placeholders in the templates, such as {{.incident.title}}
parameters.help_zh: 渲染上下文数据，为键值对结构。用于填充模板中 Go template 占位符（如 {{.incident.title}}）的数据源
parameters.name: data

fields.help_en: The template identifier. This identifier is defined by the frontend and returned as-is. Use semantic names such as title or content
fields.help_zh: 模板标识，前端自定义，原样返回。建议使用 title / content 等语义名称
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The template content string in Go template syntax
fields.help_zh: Go template 语法的模板内容字符串
fields.name: template

parameters.help_en: The list of templates to be rendered. Each item includes a template identifier and the template content
parameters.help_zh: 待渲染的模板列表，每项包含模板标识和模板内容
parameters.name: templates

data.description_en: The rendering result object, which contains two mappings: success for successfully rendered items and failed for items that failed to render
data.description_zh: 渲染结果对象，包含 success（渲染成功项）和 failed（渲染失败项）两个映射

failed.description_en: The mapping of failed rendering results. The key is the template identifier, and the value is the cause of the failure, such as a template syntax error or a reference to an undefined variable
failed.description_zh: 渲染失败的结果映射。key 为模板标识，value 为失败原因（如模板语法错误、引用了未定义变量等）

success.description_en: The mapping of successful rendering results. The key is the template identifier, which corresponds to templates[].key in the request, and the value is the rendered string content
success.description_zh: 渲染成功的结果映射。key 为模板标识（对应请求中的 templates[].key），value 为渲染后的字符串内容

msg.description_en: The processing result message. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error message if the request fails
msg.description_zh: 处理结果消息。成功时为 success，失败时为错误信息

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。取值：true（成功）、false（失败）
